rationale: rum-page-dataflow.spec.js only touches the Performance page incidentally (one test: gotoPerformance + clickRefresh + expectSummaryLoadingResolved). It is a heavyweight dataflow spec (serial CDN session generation in beforeAll) that does not cover the toolbar/toggle-group surface this feature is about (tab rendering, tab->route navigation, route->tab back-sync, deep-linking, auto-run gating, share link). This feature has its own dedicated spec_path in run-context, so it is its own area. A new lightweight spec avoids pulling the CDN dataflow dependency into pure toolbar assertions.
